cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows input + the public Windows clipboard.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: A single TextBox1 fills the form so a window-centre click (or computer-use vision click) focuses it; the capture seeds the public Windows clipboard with a repo-owned text value, then sends Ctrl+V.

TextBox1_BeforeDropOrPaste uses the plain-TextBox MdcTextEvents signature (Cancel, Action, Data, X, Y, Effect, Shift -- NO leading Index), matching the committed ctrlv-keyboard-ordering fixture. When gVetoPaste is armed it sets Cancel.Value = True.

Two scenarios: paste_baseline (gVetoPaste False) inserts the clipboard text (Change fires); paste_veto (gVetoPaste True) is the load-bearing esq.17 case -- the rows reveal whether a vetoing BeforeDropOrPaste suppresses Change and leaves TextBox1.Value unchanged.

No control fonts are declared/applied (a design-time font set hangs the SaveAs dialog). value_after is TextBox1.Value at handler entry, so a suppressed paste is visible as an unchanged value across the BeforeDropOrPaste row.
